name: edaravone
indications_original: Edaravone injection is indicated for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).
contraindications_original: Edaravone injection: The recommended dosage is 60 mg administered as an intravenous infusion over 60 minutes ( 2.1 ) Initial treatment cycle: daily dosing for 14 days followed by a 14- day drug-free period ( 2.1 ) Subsequent treatment cycles: daily dosing for 10 days out of 14- day periods, followed by 14-day drug-free periods ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Edaravone injection is supplied as a 30 mg/100 mL (0.3 mg/mL) clear, colorless, sterile solution for intravenous infusion in single-dose USP Type 1 Glass Vial 
  [see 
                           DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION (2.2)
                           and 
   HOW SUPPLIED/STORAGE AND HANDLING (16.2)]
  . These are supplied in cartons as listed below.
 
                        
                           
                              
                                 30 mg/100 mL: 
                              NDC 39822-4500-1 single-dose glass vial, 2 vial per carton NDC 39822-4500-2
  
                           
                              
                                 60 mg/100 mL:
                               NDC 39822-4510-1 single-dose glass vial, 1 vial per carton NDC 39822-4510-1
adverseReactions_original:
Edaravone injection is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to edaravone or any of the inactive ingredients in this product. Hypersensitivity reactions and anaphylactic reactions have occurred 
  [see WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS (
   5.1, 
   5.2)]
  .
